cases.acceptance_basis: First Q08 keys/proof batch qualified, overall Q08 IN_PROGRESS. Q08-F001-F003: shared bounded regular 32-byte identity/panel/session-key reads and dangling-link refusal; serialized modern/legacy migration and corrupt-legacy preservation; both client proof verifiers reject low-order static identities with zero DH. Six file checks reproduced on previous exact release; 19 current key-storage plus 25 actual restore/state checks PASS. Four new unit regressions include attacker-computable low-order proofs, bounded readers, FIFO/dangling handling and migration concurrency. Independent Python HMAC-SHA256 crosscheck: 5 HKDF wire vectors / 18 checks; no independent primitive/crypto certification claim. 2270 Linux units / 60 ignored, full/minimal Clippy and rustfmt PASS. Fresh 18/327 matrix, aggregate leak and 100 TCP + 100 QUIC/33 soak PASS. Fresh four-core native A/B, ABI/copies/provenance PASS. .11 snapshots/service/binary unchanged. Current .10 pair recorded; historical legacy IPv4 dump variability remains unattributed, no general host-preservation claim. Existing regular operator links and owner/mode preserved; no hard regular-filesystem IO deadline, power-loss or uncoordinated-root-write guarantee. Session failure preserves process-key fallback; CLI reversible storage remains best-effort. Physical advisory rows unchanged; prior AES schedule zeroization limitation retained. No deployment, push or performance benchmark. Remaining full Q08: independent primitive vectors and remaining static-binding/TOFU/RNG/nonce/rotation/zeroization/key-trust review.
